thread:
amy: Quick FYI — I'm proposing a short experiment to sunset long-lived temporary admin elevations next week. Goal is to reduce noisy admin sprawl and collect KMS/audit evidence before/after. Plan below, need volunteers for queries + rollback owner.

jordan: scope? which roles and which projects?

amy: scope = all accounts with `roles/admin` or `roles/owner` granted via temporary-elevation grant (our `temp-admin-*` tag) across prod/staging/dev. Also service accounts that got elevated via the temporary pipeline. Targeting accounts with any temp elevation older than 90 days.

amy: sampling plan: 10% random of accounts in prod, 5% staging, 3% dev. Run pre-change and post-change checks on KMS decrypt/Encrypt attempts, IAM policy changes, and audit log anomalies for 72h after change.

matt: canary idea: run on one prod project (project-redwood-canary) first, then roll to the sample set. Who owns rollback?

amy: matt volunteers as rollback owner? :) need someone to watch alerts and reapply elevations if we see failures. We should also auto-revert on any of these signals: repeated KMS decrypt errors (>5 distinct principals failing decrypt in 10m), sudden spike in 5xxs for services that use KMS, or IAM policy change rollbacks failing.

sarah: what queries do you want us to run? I can run some KMS log queries but need exact filters.

amy: example queries — paste these:  
```
-- KMS decrypt attempts last 7d for account
SELECT timestamp, principalEmail, resourceName, status
FROM kms_audit_logs
WHERE principalEmail IN (/* sample accounts */)
  AND timestamp >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 7 DAY);
```
and a quick IAM binding check:  
```
gcloud projects get-iam-policy PROJECT_ID --format=json | jq '.bindings[] | select(.role=="roles/owner" or .role=="roles/editor")'
```

jordan: I can run the pre-change queries for the prod sample. I'll post CSVs to the secure drive.

lia: for the RBAC change itself we'll open an infra PR that applies a `temporary_elevation: removed` annotation and create a small rollout job (batch of 50 accounts at a time). Use feature-flag `temp-admin-sunset` to gate. Also will include `canary=true` for the first project.

amy: perfect. lia — please also include a playbook snippet that automatically creates a revert PR if the monitoring function posts an alert to #incidents.

oncall-bot: Monitoring: KMS decrypt error spike detector active for this experiment. Alert threshold: 5 distinct principals failing within 10m.

sarah: for evidence collection, we should capture: pre/post KMS decrypt rates, number of unique principals that attempted decrypt, any increase in retry/latency for services that use KMS, and IAM change audit log entries. I'll coordinate the log retention snapshot.

matt: timeline? when do we start and how long is the experiment?

amy: proposed start = 1768884800 (next Wed 09:00 PT). Canary window = 1h, sample rollouts over following 48h, evidence window = 72h after each batch.

jordan: pinging security leads for signoff: @sarah @lia @matt.

lia: signoff from my side for infra changes. Will create PR today.

sarah: security ok with the narrow canary + rollback plan. I'll run the audit queries and keep the log snapshots.

amy: thanks — owners: lia for infra PR & rollout, jordan for pre-change data collection, sarah for audit evidence, matt as rollback watcher. I'll coordinate the runbook and post results in this thread. Any objections?

matt: no objections. :thumbsup:

jordan: no objections. I'll upload the CSVs once I run them.

amy: cool — last note: while removing temp elevations, do NOT touch keys that are marked `kms-critical=true` until we confirm usage. We'll whitelist those.

sarah: noted. I'll add a step to the query to exclude `kms-critical` resources.

amy: OK closing the planning phase. If anyone sees unexpected alerts during the canary call me and matt directly. Posting the infra PR link when ready. :lock:

oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled: will ping #eng-oncall if revert criteria met during the experiment window.
